reads.as.impactEnumUses: A value's uses are found with card_list, value.query set to the value's name (data values are searched too; a hit says where: data.<field>)
reads.as.linesRenamed: as: lines is now as: lineKinds (the kinds of line target can draw). The value's lines is the range of the body's lines (from, to)
reads.as.oneOf: as is one of impact / diagram / exists / lineKinds / markdown / picture / context
reads.as.takes.impact: a card, a field or a formatdoc row
reads.as.takes.markdown: a document, note, table or flow, a formatdoc row, or a stackdoc version
reads.as.unknown: as is one of impact / diagram / exists / lineKinds / markdown / picture / context ({other})
reads.as.what.customRow: a row of an own kind
reads.context.notBoard: as: context reads a goal or task of the board (branch: _project_board_); the tree now is {tree}
reads.context.notRead: That working directory has not been read on this machine
reads.context.notWork: as: context reads a goal or task ({path} is {kind}; read a document with as: markdown, and what a change affects with as: impact)
reads.context.oneTarget: as: context reads one goal or task (target has {count})
reads.context.treeAside: The workBranch {name} was merged into main and set aside, so this was resolved on main
reads.context.treeGone: The workBranch {name} is no longer there, so this was resolved on main
reads.context.treeUnset: The goal's workBranch is empty, so this was resolved on main
reads.groups.notCard: groups in include is the groups on the contents map of a goal or a container kind ({path} is not a card). For the groups of a section's diagram, use include: ["groups"] of section_read
reads.groups.notMapped: groups in include is the groups on the contents map of a goal or a container kind ({card} is {kind}). For the groups of a section's diagram, use include: ["groups"] of section_read
reads.guide.projectKinds: {said}. The kinds of the project {project} are: {kinds}
reads.hint.formatdocBody: Read the body with as: markdown in value (this shows only the headings and counts of the items. For one item, extend target to its path)
reads.hint.itemBody: Read the body of the items inside by reading this item {item} with as: markdown in value (the whole document: {doc})
reads.hint.stackdocBody: Read the body of a version with as: markdown in value (for one version, extend target to its path)
reads.implementation.shape: implementation is none, changed or unrecorded, or a list of them ({other} was given)
reads.in.container: in is the path of a container (goal, flow)
reads.include.placesOnly: include cannot take {other}. The values are places and groups
reads.include.unknown: include cannot take {unknown}. The values you can use are {known}
reads.kind.noOwn: . The project has no kinds of its own
reads.kind.unknown: There is no kind "{kind}" for kind (built-in kinds{own})
reads.lines.beyond: lines.from is beyond the number of lines ({count}) in the Markdown of {card}
reads.lines.fromNeeded: lines.from is required (line numbers start at 1)
reads.lines.number: lines.{key} is a line number, from 1
reads.lines.oneTarget: target of as: lines is the one place to draw lines from (a card, or a field, row or node in it; {count} given)
reads.lines.shape: lines is {from, to} (line numbers start at 1)
reads.markdown.cannotRead: as: markdown reads documents (formatdoc, freedoc, stackdoc and their versions), notes, tables (table) and flows ({card} is {kind})
reads.places.ghost: places in include is the boxes of a goal's contents map ({path} is a card ghost). For the ghost's own box use include: ["at"]; for the boxes of a section's diagram, use include: ["places"] of section_read
reads.places.notCard: places in include is the boxes of a goal's contents map ({path} is a field or the like, which has no box). For the boxes of a section's diagram, use include: ["places"] of section_read
reads.places.notMapped: places in include is the boxes of a goal's contents map ({card} is {kind}). For a card's own box use include: ["at"]; for the boxes of a section's diagram, use include: ["places"] of section_read
reads.query.alone: query is not used together with {others} (section, recursive, kind, in, limit, after and body can be used)
reads.recursive.alone: recursive is not used together with {alone} ({alone} reads one section alone)
reads.recursive.needsSection: recursive is used together with section (the section whose sections underneath are gathered)
reads.region.needsSection: region is used together with section (the section whose diagram it is on)
reads.sectionList.sectionPath: section is the path of the section to list (a string: that section and the sections inside it)
reads.settingsNotSection: Rules are not a section but the project's settings. Read them with as: rules in the value of project_read (a person edits them in Project Settings in the app). A working directory is a section directly under the root (of the kind workdir), read with section_read
